parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Which kind of reproducible run to perform. 'analysis' (default) runs your own code/notebooks and needs NO Anthropic API key. 'agent' runs the Claude Code CLI headlessly and requires the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secret.
parameters.help_text: analysis = run your notebooks/pipeline (no key needed). agent = autonomous Claude Code run (needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY).

parameters.name: prompt [agent mode]
parameters.description: Agent mode only. The prompt Claude Code runs in non-interactive mode; it exits when done. Ignored in analysis mode.

parameters.name: model [agent mode, optional]
parameters.description: Agent mode only. Claude model to use. Empty means use the Claude Code default or config.

parameters.name: effort [agent mode, optional]
parameters.description: Agent mode only. Claude Code effort level: low, medium, high, xhigh, max. Empty means default.
parameters.help_text: Supported values include low, medium, high, xhigh, and max. Empty means use the model default or config.

parameters.name: max-budget-usd [agent mode, optional]
parameters.description: Agent mode only. Max dollar amount Claude Code may spend on API calls before stopping. Leave unset for no limit.
parameters.help_text: Set the maximum dollar amount Claude Code may spend on API calls before stopping. Leave unset for no budget limit.

parameters.name: use-bedrock [agent mode, optional]
parameters.description: Agent mode only. Set to 1 to route Claude Code through Amazon Bedrock instead of the Anthropic API. Requires AWS credentials in the capsule.
parameters.help_text: Set CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK=1 to route Claude Code through Amazon Bedrock. Must add AWS credentials.

parameters.name: update-claude [agent mode, optional]
parameters.description: Agent mode only. Update the Claude Code CLI before use.
parameters.help_text: Update the Claude Code CLI tool before use.
